title: S&P 500 Breaks Out: 3 Trend Lines Point to 8,000, Then WATCH OUT!
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Inflation easing (PCE below forecast), growth-driven yields, US as best house on a bad block, strong earnings, earnings season and new-quarter inflows keep stocks rising.
Warsh raising rates shows an adult in the room, which markets read as positive.

calls.condition: At ~8000 (three converging trend lines) he will start taking shorts for a swing trade and get more conservative on longs.
calls.reason: Bull flag / inside bar breakout to a new high above the Aug 13 highs; three trend lines (pivot highs, COVID low, March 2026 low) all meet at 8000.
calls.quote: We get to 8,000. I'm going to start taking some shorts on this market.

notes: Date: host says S&P made a new all-time high 'today', taking out Aug 13 highs; matches Tue 2026-10-06 (listing approx 2026-10-07). He has been bullish since 7575; 'as we get close to 4 500 points above that level' is garbled (8000 is ~425 points above 7575). Also implies a bearish swing after 8000 is reached (not a separate time frame). 10y yield ~5.3% noted, no call on it.
